title: Change-Control and Renewal Record
purpose: Assess material changes and periodic renewal across system, data, workflow, vendor, price, law, evidence, alternatives, and exit.

records.Guidance: Model, software, data, threshold, interface, intended use, population, workflow, provider, subprocessor, hosting, price, law, evidence, or alternative.
Identify evidence, validation, economics, quality, accreditation, governance, contract, training, communication, and monitoring records requiring revision.
Classify minor, moderate, or major; record restriction, silent mode, rollback, or pause where required.
Define tests, subgroups, human factors, pilot, training, acceptance thresholds, approval, and release plan.
Reassess lifecycle cost, benefit realization, budget impact, risks, alternatives, and opportunity cost.
Continue, continue with conditions, update, restrict, pause, restart, replace, or retire.
Record fallback, data export, retention and deletion, workflow restoration, staff and patient communication, contract termination, and physical disposition.
Record accountable decision-maker, dissent, conditions, date, evidence cut-off, and next trigger.
